summary.text: Randall Greenwood is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives from District 56 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House for District 82 from 2014 to 2016.

paragraphs.text: Randall Greenwood earned a B.S. in business management from the University of Southern Maine, and his career experience includes working as a general manager.
He served in the Maine House of Representatives for District 82 from 2014 to 2016, including on the State and Local Government Committee in 2015.
Ballotpedia lists Greenwood's current tenure in the House as beginning in 2020, with the District 56 seat assumed on December 6, 2022.
He was a member of the State and Local Government Committee in 2021-2022 and its ranking member in 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
